The fluffy crab legs pair perfectly with the rice for a truly scrumptious dish.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Crab Omelets with Rice are made by combining [[Hylian Rice]], a [[Bird Egg]], [[Rock Salt]], and any [[Crab]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Regular Crab Omelets with Rice can only be made by using two different types of Crabs in the recipe or by using an ingredient with a differing effect. These types of omelets restore eight of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s}. Alternatively, they can be sold for 70 [[Rupee]]s. The fluffy Crab legs are known to pair perfectly with the rice. Three different variations of Crab Omelets with Rice exist, correlating with all three different types of Crabs: * '''Energizing Crab Omelet with Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Crab Omelet with Rice}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The fluffy crab legs pair perfectly with the rice for a truly scrumptious dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using a [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]. Consuming one will partially refill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. They restore six of his Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Mighty Crab Omelet with Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Crab Omelet with Rice}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The fluffy crab legs pair perfectly with the rice for a truly scrumptious dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using a [[Razorclaw Crab]]. When eaten, they will temporarily boost Link's attack power. They also restore nine of his Hearts and sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Tough Crab Omelet with Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Crab Omelet with Rice}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The fluffy crab legs pair perfectly with the rice for a truly scrumptious dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using an [[Ironshell Crab]]. If they are consumed, they increase Link's [[Defense]] for a short period of time. They heal Link for seven Hearts and sell for 60 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Crab Risotto * Crab Stir-Fry * Food * Meal * Salt-Grilled Crab }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Omelets, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
